pdf_storage_upload.contract: Zotero Web API v3 full file-upload protocol

annotation_write.contract: Generic Web API item creation is permitted only with exact trusted geometry. Text-only coordinate fabrication is forbidden.

annotation_to_note.contract: Web API note writes plus Zotero Desktop data-annotation/data-citation HTML structure; not claimed as a native server-side Add Note from Annotations endpoint.

duplicate_merge.contract: No native Web API merge endpoint is exposed; pseudo-merge is forbidden.

saved_searches.contract: Native Saved Search metadata CRUD; Web API exposes saved-search metadata and criteria, not result execution.
